findings.claim: The pre-lease self-test still certifies broken per-phase measurements. Four independently authored faulty versions pass BOTH required self-test commands and can report SACH after failed probes, empty observations, an unchecked table row, or an omitted go phase. The unmodified classifier checks only observation count, not the exact phase identities.
manifestations: S11-r9-a: ignoring only probe return codes survives all 19 cases and 12 supplied mutants; probes actually exiting 42 are classified SACH by this faulty driver.
S11-r9-b: filling an empty probe observation with its witness survives the complete self-test and turns the original KHONG_DO_DUOC into SACH. Unit fault injection only updates obs[3], the suite.
S11-r9-c: checking rows[:-1] while reporting so_hang=30 survives the complete self-test; an erroneous hop_dong_gan_dung outcome is then accepted.
S11-r9-d: nguyen,bon,bon omits go but is accepted SACH and survives the complete self-test. The unchanged phan_loai also accepts four nguyen observations with no bon/go/suite.

Original -> mutant: rc42 probes KHONG_DO_DUOC -> SACH; empty probe sets KHONG_DO_DUOC -> SACH; last-row mismatch KHONG_DO_DUOC -> SACH; omitted go still SACH. Healthy original runs retain correct behavior.

suggested_fix.where_and_why: Repair the admission measurement contract and do_vung_pr2.py phase collector/classifier/self-tests together, then align Acceptance 4. These components decide whether a measurement actually covers the required invocations.
suggested_fix.how: Require the exact closed set of phase identities, once each, with results bound to the corresponding invocation. Exercise each failure at the collection boundary separately for every phase, not only on a synthetic suite record. Check every frozen row and use a counterexample that changes only that row. Preserve the three outcomes and the existing independent witnesses.
suggested_fix.locking_test_and_mutant: The four measured survivors must die for their own reason. Run rc42 after positive output, empty probe observation, single last-row mismatch, omitted/duplicated phase, healthy and out-of-zone controls. Assert phase identities and per-phase outcomes, rather than only the aggregate conclusion. Existing child/cwd/relabel mutants must remain killed.
suggested_fix.regression_risk: Do not fabricate missing witnesses, union observations across phases, reject a healthy standalone probe using the suite witness, or make an unrelated failure count as a killed mutant.
